hook: vast dark ocean swell at dawn seen from a ship's bow, a burning orange sun line, spray in the air, deep blue and gold

02-yin-wood: two kopi cups in glass mugs on a marble kopitiam table, steam rising, morning sun through shutters

04-yin-fire: a neat desk with a fountain pen, a tidy folder and a small brass desk lamp, evening office, warm pool of light
05-yang-earth: a door ajar onto a bright corridor with a shaft of golden light on the floor, an envelope on the threshold
06-yin-earth: paid bills stacked neatly with a calculator and a cup of tea on a wooden table, soft late-afternoon light
07-yang-metal: a hawker centre table at night under string lights, plates of satay and sambal, steam and warm bokeh
08-yin-metal: a phone on a cafe table showing a single typed message bubble, a cup of black coffee, rainy window behind

10-yin-water: a relay baton resting on a running track at sunrise, long shadows, mist, gold light
